description.value: Raglan's Bistro is a casual comfort-food restaurant that has anchored the Lower Lonsdale Shipyards District since 1999, serving tacos, burgers, burritos, poutine, and an extensive roster of tiki and boat drinks in a deliberately beachy atmosphere. The kitchen smokes its own cheeses, cures artisan bacon, and braises pulled pork overnight, giving the menu a made-from-scratch character unusual for its casual price point. A large outdoor patio and full takeout/delivery service make it a practical meal stop for cyclists passing through North Vancouver.
